heading.purpose: A document's or an inspector's title.

small.purpose: Inspector field labels, counts, secondary facts.

shadows.name: window
shadows.purpose: A floating window; rgba(0,0,0,0.20) in the light theme.

shadows.name: popup
shadows.purpose: A menu or popup; rgba(0,0,0,0.16) in the light theme.

components.name: Button
components.description: The resting control; hover lifts the fill and strokes it in the accent.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #2a2d33; color: #cccccc; border: 1px solid #6e737c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; font: 12.5px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #383c44; border-color: #0078d4; } .ds-btn:active { background: #183c59; color: #ffffff; border-color: #68afe5; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #68afe5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace Button
components.description: The workspace on show: the one filled use of the accent in the shell.
components.css: .ds-ws { display: inline-block; width: 88px; height: 22px; line-height: 22px; text-align: center; border-radius: 4px; color: #cccccc; font: 12.5px/22px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-ws:hover { background: #383c44; } .ds-ws-on, .ds-ws-on:hover { background: #0078d4; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Document Tab
components.description: An open document; the tab on show carries a two-pixel accent line along its top.
components.css: .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px; background: #212429; color: #aaaaaa; font: 12.5px Inter, sans-serif; border-top: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #cccccc; } .ds-tab-on { background: #2a2d33; color: #cccccc; border-top-color: #0078d4; } .ds-tab-kind { width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 1.5px solid #6ac86a; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-tab-dirty { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #cca700; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A field in the well colour, with a placeholder that says what it accepts.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1a1c20; color: #cccccc; border: 1px solid #6e737c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 6px; font: 12.5px Inter, sans-serif; caret-color: #68afe5; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #aaaaaa; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #0078d4; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #68afe5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A bordered card that lifts by fill and outline, never by shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #212429; color: #cccccc; border: 1px solid #383c44; border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px; font: 12.5px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card small { color: #aaaaaa; font-size: 10.5px; } .ds-card:hover { background: #2a2d33; border-color: #6e737c; }

narrative.overview: A neutral dark bench where the asset is the only colourful thing. Panels are flat graphite in four close steps, text is grey on grey at a ratio that has been measured, and one blue marks where the user is. The bench is dense on purpose: sessions are long, a dozen documents are open at once, and the inspector shows offsets, hashes and sizes that have to be read exactly. Copy is part of the look: no surface sells anything.
keyCharacteristics: Flat graphite panels, separated by a one-pixel border and never by shadow.
One accent, blue, kept for place, focus and selection.
Colour otherwise belongs to file kinds, states and the asset itself.
Small type, tight spacing, monospace for every value read from a file.
Every text colour reaches 4.5 to 1 on every panel, in both themes, by test.
Two themes and a user-chosen accent, scale and font: nothing is a constant.

rules.name: The Place Rule
rules.body: Blue says where you are and what is selected: the active workspace, the tab on show, the focused widget, the selection, a link. This is guidance, not a prohibition; a new use of the accent should be able to say which of those it is.

rules.name: The Measured Text Rule
rules.body: A text colour is judged by its contrast ratio on every panel and on a selection, 4.5 to 1 for text and 3 to 1 for a mark that carries meaning.

rules.name: The Resolved Colour Rule
rules.body: A themed colour is read at draw time, never stored as a constant, because the user picks the theme and the accent.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: There is no bold face in the bundle. Emphasis is the strong text colour, which is white on dark and black on light.

rules.name: The User's Font Rule
rules.body: The user may pick a system font, the monospace, a scale and a language. A layout that depends on Inter's exact widths is broken.

rules.name: The Flat Dock Rule
rules.body: A docked panel never casts a shadow, and a card lifts on hover by changing its fill and outline, not by rising.

dos: Do take every colour from the theme, read at draw time.
Do pass a colour that is not a palette slot through the theme's legibility helper before drawing text or a meaningful icon with it.
Do separate panels with the divider and controls with the stronger outline.
Do set file values (offsets, hashes, sizes, paths) in monospace.
Do check a screen in both themes and in a long-string and a CJK language.
donts: Don't hard-code a hex in a panel; a constant draws dark-theme colours on the light theme's white.
Don't put a shadow on a docked panel or a card.
Don't dim text below quiet text to show it is disabled.
Don't add a second weight or a second interface font.
Don't centre-and-justify a message that can wrap.
